references.text: God humbled the enemies before Israel, a recurring theme of God's intervention in battle.
God humiliated the Philistines, parallel to how God subdued Jabin, king of Canaan.
The Lord promised to subdue the peoples before Israel, fulfilling the promise in Judges.
God humbles His enemies, thematically parallel to God's victory over Jabin.
The same chapter describes how the Lord scattered Sisera and his entire army, leading to Jabin's defeat.
